state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the taxi allowance for a daytime business taxi ride today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per ride)
- Q2: What home-office equipment allowance applied to a regular employee on 2026-03-15? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the flight fare limit for a standard return flight within Europe with checked equipment today? (answer in EUR per return flight)
- Q4: What is the monthly parking allowance for a city-centre employee with an assigned company parking space today? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q5: What is the nightly lodging limit for a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q6: What is the bike-leasing allowance for a regular employee leasing an e-bike with the insurance package today? (answer in EUR per month)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: flight fare limit return flight Europe checked equipment

passages.source: HB-56 §3 | Travel policy: flights — Additions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-10
passages.text: For flights that require checked equipment, 50 EUR per return flight is added to the standard flight fare limit. Managers confirm claims for the flight fare limit before payment in the next payroll run. The travel office publishes worked examples of the flight fare limit on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-10 §2 | Travel policy: flights — Standard flight fare limit | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-03-01 to the day before 2026-05-01 · superseded by: HB-56
passages.text: The flight fare limit for an economy return flight was 325 EUR. Questions about the flight fare limit go to the travel office, who keeps the record of decisions. The travel office publishes worked examples of the flight fare limit on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-56 §2 | Travel policy: flights — Standard flight fare limit | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-10
passages.text: The flight fare limit for an economy return flight is 400 EUR. Managers confirm claims for the flight fare limit before payment in the next payroll run. Claims for the flight fare limit are filed in the expense tool under 'Travel policy: flights'.

passages.source: HB-62 §2 | Memo: flight fare limit exceptions — Exception for intercontinental flights | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
passages.text: For intercontinental flights, the flight fare limit is 800 EUR per return flight instead of the standard amount. Claims for the flight fare limit are filed in the expense tool under 'Travel policy: flights'. The travel office publishes worked examples of the flight fare limit on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-09 §7 | Policy FAQ: travel and expenses — Current flight fare limit | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard flight fare limit? A: 400 EUR per return flight, as set in HB-56 §2 (effective 2026-05-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-62.

passages.source: HB-62 §1 | Memo: flight fare limit exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the flight fare limit in HB-56. The travel office publishes worked examples of the flight fare limit on the intranet. Each claim for the flight fare limit needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.
